summary: TWO BEDROOM TERRACED HOME This large two bedroom home is located just off the A690 in Houghton le Spring, the property has easy access to local bus routes and to main roads towards Durham and Sunderland. Accommodation downstairs comprises of lounge, kitchen, a room which can be used as a office/bedroom and a downstairs bathroom with over bath shower. Upstairs comprises of two large double bedrooms, bathroom with a shower. Property has gas central heating, fully double glazed and a yard to the rear.
